register.labelZh: GO AROUND 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GO AROUND Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: GO AROUND 可以表示某事物環繞另一事物,亦可以描述某人繞過彎位或障礙物。；go around with somebody 適合用來談論友誼和某人經常一起活動的群體。；GO AROUND 可以描述走遍某個地方,逐一查看房間、與人交談或派發物品。；go around doing something 可以表示某人在不同地方或對不同的人重複做某事。
register.summaryEn: GO AROUND can show that something surrounds an object or that someone moves past a bend or obstacle. Go around with somebody is useful when discussing friendships and regular social groups. GO AROUND can describe moving through a place to check rooms, speak to people or give things to them. Go around doing something can show an action that someone repeatedly performs in different places or with many people.
